title: 馬克白 2-3~4 門房與加冕
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek

panels.prompt: a drunken porter with a lantern and ale jug stumbling through a dark castle gatehouse, comically grumbling, the great door shaking with huge knocking, exaggerated cartoonish shadows

dialogue.speaker: 門房
dialogue.text: 敲，敲！憑著魔鬼的名義，誰在那兒？要是在地獄裡當管門人，光拔閂開鎖就夠他忙的了。
dialogue.en: Knock, knock! Who's there, i' th' name of Beelzebub? If a man were porter of hell-gate, he should have old turning the key.

panels.prompt: the porter swinging the great gate open with a mock bow, cold grey morning light flooding in over two cloaked noblemen

dialogue.speaker: 門房
dialogue.text: 可是這兒太冷，當不成地獄。請記著我這看門的。
dialogue.en: But this place is too cold for hell. I pray you, remember the porter.

panels.prompt: Macduff, a burly thane with a thick unkempt red-brown beard, a jagged boar-tusk pendant at his neck, in a weathered grey-green tartan cloak, standing at the castle gate in morning light, impatient

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 王上叫我一早就來叫他——我幾乎誤了時間。
dialogue.en: He did command me to call timely on him: I have almost slipped the hour.

panels.prompt: a tall dark-haired lord in a hastily thrown-on robe greeting guests in a stone corridor, eyes shadowed and sleepless, gesturing toward a door

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 我帶您去看王上。……這門裡就是。
dialogue.en: I'll bring you to him. … This is the door.

panels.prompt: a windswept castle corridor, tapestries billowing, a young nobleman glancing uneasily at the storm-damaged rafters

dialogue.speaker: 列諾克斯
dialogue.text: 昨晚的暴風把煙囪都吹倒了——還有人聽見空中有哀哭的聲音。
dialogue.en: The night has been unruly: chimneys were blown down, and lamentings heard i' th' air.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 果然是一個可怕的晚上。

panels.prompt: Macduff, red-brown wild beard, boar-tusk pendant, bursting from a royal bedchamber with face white with horror, screaming down a torchlit corridor, servants recoiling

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 可怕！可怕！可怕！大逆不道的兇手，打開了王上的聖殿，把生命偷走了！
dialogue.en: O horror, horror, horror! Most sacrilegious murder hath broke ope the Lord's anointed temple, and stole thence the life o' the building!

panels.prompt: an alarm bell swinging wildly in a stone bell tower against a bruised dawn sky, crows scattering

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 醒來！醒來！敲起警鐘——起來瞧瞧世界末日的影子！
dialogue.en: Awake, awake! Ring the alarum-bell! Up, up, and see the great doom's image!

panels.prompt: torchlit royal bedchamber doorway, a dark-haired lord standing over two slain grooms with a dripping dagger, stunned courtiers crowding the doorway behind him

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 我後悔一時魯莽把他們殺了——可是誰能在驚愕之中保持冷靜，在忠憤之中保持鎮定？
dialogue.en: O, yet I do repent me of my fury, that I did kill them. Who can be wise, amazed, temperate and furious, loyal and neutral, in a moment?

panels.prompt: Lady Macbeth, pale noblewoman with long straight black hair, in a deep crimson gown with a high collar, swooning backward into attendants' arms, watched sidelong by a braided-bearded warrior with narrowed eyes

dialogue.speaker: 班柯（內心）
dialogue.text: 我一定要從尚未揭發的假面具下面，探出叛逆的陰謀。
dialogue.en: Against the undivulged pretence I fight of treasonous malice.

panels.prompt: two young princes whispering urgently in a dark stable, saddling horses by a single lantern, straw and long shadows

dialogue.speaker: 馬爾康
dialogue.text: 假裝悲哀，是奸人的拿手好戲。我去英格蘭。
dialogue.en: To show an unfelt sorrow is an office which the false man does easy. I'll to England.

dialogue.speaker: 道納本
dialogue.text: 我去愛爾蘭。這裡的人，笑臉裡都藏著利刃。
dialogue.en: To Ireland, I. There's daggers in men's smiles.

quote.text: 這裡的人，笑臉裡都藏著利刃

panels.prompt: two riders galloping out of a castle gate in opposite directions under a blood-streaked dawn sky

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 殺人的利箭已經射出——避開它的目標，是唯一的活路。
dialogue.en: This murderous shaft that's shot hath not yet lighted, and our safest way is to avoid the aim.

panels.prompt: an ancient white-haired man and a thane in a grey travel-stained cloak talking outside castle walls under an unnaturally dark daytime sky, a dead falcon on the ground with an owl perched above it, two horses fighting in a far field

dialogue.speaker: 老翁
dialogue.text: 活了七十年，沒見過這樣的夜晚。白晝變成了黑夜，鷹被貓頭鷹啄死——鄧肯的馬，吃了自己的同類。
dialogue.en: Threescore and ten I can remember well … A falcon was by a mousing owl hawked at and killed; and Duncan's horses ate each other.

panels.prompt: black-bordered title-card style panel, a small distant vignette of a crown being lowered onto a shadowed head in an abbey, heavy blacks all around

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 王位落到了馬克白頭上，加冕在斯貢。麥克德夫沒有去觀禮——他回費輔去了。
dialogue.en: Macbeth is named king, and crowned at Scone. Macduff is gone home to Fife.
